verdict.rationale: Decagon offers voice AI agents for natural, multilingual phone conversations and can place outbound calls. Its integrations explicitly let the agent retrieve data and take actions across chat, email, and voice, so the core of shared actions on a phone channel is claimed. Evidence is only short vendor marketing lines, though. Missing for 10: detail on speech recognition/synthesis and telephony setup, explicit confirmation that the same knowledge base and AOPs apply to voice as to chat, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of voice quality.
